name: Ring of Light Blows
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 3rd; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring looks like a ring of mighty blows. If a successful attack does not succeed by 5 or more points, the attack does the minimum damage.

Additionally, the wearer suffer a -2 penalty to confirm critical hits.

Casting true strike and remove curse upon the ring allows the wearer to remove it, rendering the ring non-magical.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of mighty blows

Identification DC 28
False Identification DC 18
